title: Numbers come from tools, never Vana

rows.label:
Athlete asks about
fuelling or races

Vana invents a
number or a meal

Tools: upcoming events,
activity history,
macro targets, foods

Deterministic module
pre, during, post targets

example: 'What races are coming up?' The events tool answers:
Birmingham Half, 12 Oct. Its fuelling targets come from
the module; Vana reads them out and adds nothing.
